doc.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Writing bebop arrangements in the Eckstine mold
summary: Foster says his Collegians writing was bebop and modeled on Billy Eckstine and Dizzy Gillespie rather than Basie.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: How would you characterize your writing for the Collegians? In what style? Your Frank Foster style, or were you working some particular style?
I was a strong admirer of Billy Eckstine at the time, his band’s approach.

Oh, it was definitely bebop, yeah. Yeah, it was the bebop. Billy Eckstine, Dizzy Gillespie, that was my model as a big band. It wasn’t so much Basie at that time. I had left Basie and gone over to Billy Eckstine and Dizzy.
